author: MacDlightful
quote: GTA 6 is quite literally the most overhyped game of all time. When I went into this game, I had the highest expectations EVER, only to be met with a disappointing story, lackluster gameplay, and busywork side missions. We waited 13 years for The Sims meet Florida. Because all this game is, is just a Florida simulator, not GTA.

author: MacDlightful
quote: This game truly does deserve the title of “Greatest Game of all time”. As someone who never played the original, Ocarina of Time still stands out for its innovative gameplay, excellent story, memorable characters, and charming visuals. This remake only proved that. 11/10
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
